provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from YAML 1.2.2 and the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, sections 5.4 and 6, with the explicit limits of the yamlprims-core-stress r1 profile.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Block mappings of 10 to 100,000 keys sharing a 32-byte prefix, each also with the first key repeated last, which is a duplicate key. Format events for both; the duplicate is decided by YAML and the profile. Bound to an explicit-limits profile so that the expected error is the first one; the generator checks every competing limit for each row with an error.
